complexity.reason: One saved reply changes, and the ticket contains the old and the new support hours.

understanding:
The saved reply for delayed orders lists support hours of 9:00 to 17:00. Since 2026-10-01, support answers from 8:00 to 20:00, on weekends too. The ticket asks that the reply give the new hours.
Assumptions:
The reply states the hours in the same time zone as before.

in: Change the support hours in the saved reply for delayed orders to 8:00 to 20:00, every day.

approach.summary: Replace 9:00 to 17:00 with 8:00 to 20:00 in the delayed-order reply, add that the hours apply every day, and keep the rest of the text.

alternatives.summary: Replace the hours with a link to the help page that lists them.
alternatives.reason: The instruction keeps the change to this reply, and a customer would need one more step to find the hours.
